name: shap_review
description: Evidence-driven SHAP repository review toolkit. Runs semantic analysis, contract oracles, fuzzing, differential analysis, and evidence-chain validation against a SHAP source checkout. SECURITY: commands 'differential', 'reproduce', 'sanitizer', 'cpu-gpu-differential', and 'differential-versions' execute arbitrary Python scripts via subprocess — only use with trusted, controlled paths.

arguments.description: Command-specific keyword arguments. The 'root' key specifies the repository path for analysis commands.
